metadata.processing_notes: Comprehensive extraction from 48 colony/territory files. All geographic entities, people with salaries and titles, institutions, economic data, infrastructure, demographics, and historical events extracted with exact historical spelling preserved. Data covers administrative structure, personnel, trade, population, geography, and colonial infrastructure of the British Empire in 1936.

extraction_notes.geographic_entities: Extracted coordinates, areas, descriptions of all major colonies and territories. Preserved exact historical spelling and measurements as written in 1936 documents.
extraction_notes.people: Extracted names, titles, honors, positions, and salaries where listed. Data includes government officials, administrators, and colonial personnel from multiple colonies.
extraction_notes.institutions: Councils, courts, departments, advisory committees, and administrative bodies extracted with composition and function descriptions.
extraction_notes.economic_data: Revenue, exports, imports, shipping data, and production figures extracted with original currency denominations (primarily £ sterling and colony-specific currencies).
extraction_notes.infrastructure: Railways, telegraph lines, docks, postal routes, water systems, and public works extracted with specifications and locations.
extraction_notes.demographics: Population statistics, census data, ethnic breakdowns extracted with original categories and historical classifications preserved.
extraction_notes.historical_events: Establishment dates, treaties, constitutional changes, rebellions, and disasters extracted with dates and participating locations/people.
